    com.eqixiac.equinix.design
    Value-add design engines built on top of the Equinix API clients: placement optimization, deployment planning, pricing/TCO analysis, peering intelligence, latency physics, and infrastructure-as-code export.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.export
    Exporters that render design-engine output into portable, version-controllable text formats.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.geo
    Latency physics: SpeedOfLightLatency computes speed-of-light-in-fibre latency floors (one-way or round-trip) and haversine great-circle distances between IBXes, metros, or raw coordinates — fully offline once the endpoints' coordinates are known.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer
    The Metro Optimization Engine: scores, ranks, and selects Equinix metros for a deployment from user sites, provider requirements, workloads, and constraints, against live Fabric catalog data.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.enums
    Enumerations that parameterize the Metro Optimization Engine: OptimizationStrategy (scoring weight presets), WorkloadType (workload archetypes with built-in profiles), LatencySensitivity (default per-workload placement ceilings), SiteRole (site importance multipliers), RedundancyTier (metro-count floors and region-diversity selection), ComplianceZone (region-based data-sovereignty zones with deployment-level AND semantics), ScoreCategory (the five scoring dimensions), and RiskSeverity (risk-finding levels).
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.model
    Immutable value types for the Metro Optimization Engine — the request side (sites, provider requirements, workload specs, constraints, scoring weights) and the result side (ranked recommendations, scores, topology, latency matrix, risk assessment, cost estimates).
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard
    The Deployment Wizard: turns a metro OptimizationResult into an executable DeploymentPlan — Cloud Routers, provider connections, inter-metro backbone links, and routing protocols, with bandwidth-aware profile selection and honestly-reconciled pricing.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.enums
    Configuration enums for the Deployment Wizard: BackboneTopology (how the recommended metros are meshed with inter-metro backbone links), BandwidthStrategy (how provider connections are sized from workload requirements), and ConnectionPurpose (what role a planned connection plays in the plan).
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model
    Value types for the Deployment Wizard — the plan itself and everything it is made of, plus the execution-side inputs and outcomes.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering
    Peering Intelligence: interconnection analysis combining PeeringDB IX/facility data with the live Equinix Fabric catalog.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.client
    Lightweight PeeringDB REST client and its wire models — a credential and transport entirely separate from the Equinix OAuth client.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.enums
    Classification enums for Peering Intelligence: ConnectivityType (how an ASN is reachable at a metro — IX, Fabric, both, facility-only, none), PeeringPolicy and NetworkType (parsed from PeeringDB's policy_general / info_type fields), DiversityRating (distance-banded geographic diversity, with UNKNOWN reserved for unavailable distances), and FailureScope (blast-radius failure domains).
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.peering.model
    Result value types for Peering Intelligence, all Lombok @Value (get-prefixed accessors) unless a hand-written accessor is documented.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value
    The value-realization layer of the design API: design-time cost modelling that puts a money figure on an interconnect decision.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard
    Rate cards: pluggable sources of unit prices for the design-time cost, savings, and TCO models.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.ratecard.provider
    Live cloud-provider pricing adapters: RateCard implementations that source current data-egress list prices from the providers' public pricing APIs — AwsPriceListRateCard (AWS Price List bulk offers), AzureRetailPricesRateCard (Azure Retail Prices), GcpBillingCatalogRateCard (GCP Cloud Billing Catalog; the only one needing an API key), and OracleCloudPriceListRateCard (OCI Price List).
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.savings
    Cloud-egress savings estimation: how much routing a monthly data volume over an Equinix private interconnect saves versus egressing it to the public internet, net of the Equinix interconnect cost.
    com.eqixiac.equinix.design.value.tco
    Design-time total-cost-of-ownership comparison across three DeploymentArchetypes — public cloud over the internet, on-premises, and Equinix-interconnected.
